$description: Slonview brand-to-UI tokens (Stage 3). Values are sRGB; light and dark follow prefers-color-scheme.

accent.role: Brand accent: primary buttons, links, active tab text, selected header fill, sort arrows, view/matview icons

accent-hover.role: Hover/pressed accent fill (replaces filter: brightness(1.08)). Dark hover darkens, keeping protan ΔE ≥ 45 from red

accent-fg.role: Text and icons on accent fills. Dark theme flips to ink

replaces.light: index.css:139 .btn-primary color #fff; TableTab:85 and ContextMenu:80 text-white / hover:text-white / focus-visible:text-white on bg-accent; ResultGrid accentFg #ffffff, textHeaderSelected #ffffff, and draw-callback literals at :269 (PK), :280 (column name), :303 (sort arrow) isSelected ? #ffffff
replaces.dark: same literals (white on lilac would be 1.92:1)

accent-fg-muted.role: Secondary text on accent fills (type name on a selected header)

replaces.light: ResultGrid:290 isSelected ? rgba(255,255,255,0.75); ContextMenu:83 shortcut opacity-60 on the highlighted (bg-accent) item
replaces.dark: same (75 % white on lilac would be 1.65:1; 60 % ink on lilac is 3.64:1)

accent-soft.role: Selected list item (sidebar relation, connection list); 3 px focus halo on fields

replaces.light: --fg #1c1f24; text-fg; ResultGrid text #1c1f24; text-neutral-900; text-neutral-800; hover:text-neutral-900; ResultsPanel text-red-900 (error panel body)
replaces.dark: --fg #dfe2e7; ResultGrid text #dfe2e7; dark:text-neutral-100; dark:text-neutral-200; dark:hover:text-neutral-100; dark:text-red-200 (error panel body)

replaces.light: --app #ffffff; bg-app; ResultGrid bg #ffffff; bg-white; SqlEditor bg-white

surface.role: Sidebar, toolbars, status bar, filter bar, editor gutter

surface-2.role: Hover fill, zebra rows, pressed toolbar buttons, splitter

replaces.light: --hover #e8eaee; bg-hover; hover:bg-neutral-200; ResultGrid bgAlt #f6f7f9; bg-neutral-100; bg-neutral-200

border.role: Dividers and panel edges (decorative, not a control boundary)

replaces.light: --line #e1e4e8; border-line; bg-line; ResultGrid border #e3e5e9 (also bgHeaderHasFocus/Hovered); border-neutral-200

border-strong.role: Input, select and checkbox boundaries (≥ 3:1, WCAG 1.4.11)

replaces.light: .field border var(--line) (1.3:1); border-neutral-300; border-faint (dashed colour swatch, ConnectionList dot ring)

--muted #5e6570; text-muted; ResultGrid muted #5e6570; text-neutral-500; text-neutral-600; text-neutral-700; ContextMenu:83 shortcut opacity-60 (unhighlighted item); Sidebar:182 row-count text-faint when the row is active (on accent-soft)

faint.role: Tertiary text: counts, type names, placeholders, WHERE label, search icons. Text-safe (≥ 4.5:1) everywhere except selection

replaces.light: --faint #9aa1ab (2.61:1, fails); text-faint; bg-faint (status dot); ResultGrid faint #a0a6b0; text-neutral-400 and placeholder:text-neutral-400 (HistoryPanel:88, :95; 2.58:1, fails)

selection.role: Selected cells / range fill (opaque so text contrast is checkable); editor text selection

selection-fg-muted.role: Any secondary text drawn on selection: NULL marker, faint text, PK marker, editor comments. faint, null-fg and warn are not allowed on selection

replaces.light: ResultGrid nullTheme textDark (faint) when the cell is selected; PK marker on selection

row-highlight.role: Hovered or focused row, keyboard-focused history item, editor active line

null-fg.role: NULL marker (italic) in unselected grid cells and the inspector. Switches to selection-fg-muted inside a selection

replaces.light: ResultGrid nullTheme textDark = faint #a0a6b0; CellInspector:116 text-faint

focus-ring.role: 2 px focus outline on every control

replaces.light: :focus-visible outline var(--accent); focus-visible:outline-blue-500 (HistoryPanel, ResultsPanel, SqlTab); focus-within:border-blue-500; ring-accent; .field:focus border-color

splitter-hover.role: Hovered resize handle (1 px line at full accent)

readonly-fg.role: READ-ONLY badge text (badge is outlined, no fill)

write-bg.role: WRITE badge fill. Red is reserved for WRITE and errors

error.role: Error text, error icons, destructive button fill, SQL error underline, error panel border

replaces.light: --danger #d1343b; text-danger; bg-danger (btn); border-danger/40; text-red-600; text-red-700; border-red-300; SqlEditor underline #ef4444

error-fg.role: Text on error fills (destructive button). Dark flips to ink

error-soft.role: Error panel and error badge background; SQL error mark background

replaces.light: --danger-soft rgba(209, 52, 59, 0.08); bg-danger-soft; bg-red-50; bg-red-100; SqlEditor rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)

error-meta.role: SQLSTATE and position lines inside an error panel (same value as muted)

warn.role: Warnings, connecting dot, PK marker in unselected grid headers

replaces.light: --warn #b7791f (3.64:1, fails); text-warn; bg-warn; ResultGrid pk #b7791f; text-amber-700

warn-soft.role: PK badge background in the Structure tab

syntax-comment.role: Comments, italic (= muted; faint fails on selection)

editor-error-underline.role: Wavy underline under the error position (= error)

editor-error-bg.role: Background behind the error position (= error-soft)

rules: On selection, secondary text (faint, null-fg, warn/PK) switches to selection-fg-muted.
On accent-soft (selected list item), faint text (counts, type names) switches to muted.
On accent fills, text uses accent-fg; secondary text uses accent-fg-muted.
On error fills, text uses error-fg.
Never lower text contrast with opacity or alpha (opacity-*, text-*/NN, inline opacity). Use muted, faint or accent-fg-muted. Disabled controls and show/hide toggles are the only exceptions.
